agreementScreen.title: Agreement
agreementScreen.subtitle: Review and sign the liability agreement before the project begins.
agreementScreen.bothSign: Both parties must review and sign the liability agreement before the project can begin.
agreementScreen.summary: This agreement governs the working relationship between the student and the employer facilitated through InternsHub. It outlines expectations, IP ownership, confidentiality obligations, and dispute resolution procedures for the duration of the placement.
agreementScreen.conduct: Code of conduct and professional behavior
agreementScreen.sectionConfidentialityText: The Student agrees to keep all employer information, client data, business strategies, and technical materials strictly confidential during and after the placement period.
agreementScreen.sectionIntellectualPropertyText: All work products, designs, code, and deliverables created during the placement are the property of the Employer unless otherwise agreed in writing.
agreementScreen.sectionConductText: The Student agrees to maintain professional behavior, meet agreed deadlines, and communicate proactively with the employer about blockers or challenges.
agreementScreen.sectionHoursText: The Student and Employer shall agree on a weekly schedule. Overtime must be mutually agreed upon and compensated as per the offer terms.
agreementScreen.sectionTerminationText: Either party may raise concerns through InternsHub. Both parties will make a good-faith effort to resolve disputes before ending the placement.

novatechFrontend.description: Join our engineering team to build modern, performant web applications used by 50k+ users.
responsibilities: Build reusable, accessible React components with TypeScript
Collaborate with designers to implement pixel-perfect, responsive UIs
Optimize application performance, LCP, and CLS metrics
Write unit and integration tests using Vitest and Testing Library
Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and technical discussions
requirements: 1+ year of experience with React and TypeScript
Strong command of CSS, Flexbox, Grid, and Tailwind
Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and PR workflows
Clear written communication in English or Arabic
A portfolio with at least one shipped, real-world project
novatechFrontend.companyDescription: NovaTech Solutions is a product-led tech company building tools for the modern workforce. Founded in 2019, we serve 50k+ users across the MENA region.

designcraftUiux.description: Help shape user experiences for our client portfolio of SaaS and e-commerce products.
responsibilities: Create user flows and interactive prototypes
Conduct usability sessions and synthesize findings
Work closely with product and engineering teams
requirements: A portfolio showing thoughtful UX decisions
Working knowledge of Figma and design systems
Curiosity, clear communication, and a collaborative mindset
designcraftUiux.companyDescription: DesignCraft is an independent product design studio partnering with ambitious teams to make digital products easier to use.

startupflowProduct.description: Own the product design for a fast-growing fintech startup. End-to-end responsibility from research to delivery.
responsibilities: Lead discovery and translate insights into product improvements
Design and maintain a consistent component library
Partner with product managers to shape the roadmap
requirements: Strong interaction design and prototyping skills
Comfort working in a fast-moving startup environment
startupflowProduct.companyDescription: StartupFlow helps small teams understand their finances with clear, approachable software.

cloudbaseReact.description: Build internal tools and customer-facing dashboards using React and our design system.
responsibilities: Build and maintain React interfaces for cloud products
Integrate REST APIs and handle loading and error states
Work with QA to resolve issues before release
requirements: Comfort with JavaScript and React fundamentals
Understanding of responsive CSS and accessibility
A willingness to learn and work as part of a team
cloudbaseReact.companyDescription: CloudBase builds dependable infrastructure and collaboration products for businesses throughout the region.
